```c
if (mrb_float_p(end)) {
  mrb_float a = (mrb_float)mrb_integer(beg);
  mrb_float b = mrb_float(end);

  if (a > b) {
    return mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, 0);
  }
  ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1);
  mrb_value *ptr = RARRAY_PTR(ary);
  mrb_int i = 0;
  if (RANGE_EXCL(r)) {
    while (a < b) {
      ptr[i++] = mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a);
      ARY_SET_LEN(RARRAY(ary), i);
      a += 1.0;
    }
  }
  else {
    while (a <= b) {
      ptr[i++] = mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a);
      ARY_SET_LEN(RARRAY(ary), i);
      a += 1.0;
    }
  }
  return ary;
}
```

The capacity is `(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1`. The loop runs while `a <= b` (inclusive), incrementing a by 1.0.

Number of iterations in inclusive case: count of a values a0, a0+1, ..., a0+k where a0+k <= b. = floor(b - a0) + 1 (when b - a0 is integer, a0..b inclusive = (b-a0)+1 iterations; when b-a0 non-integer, floor(b-a0)+1 iterations).

Capacity = (mrb_int)(b - a0) + 1.

So normally they match: floor(b-a0)+1 == (mrb_int)(b-a0)+1. 

The bug must be a floating point precision issue where `(mrb_int)(b - a)` (computed as float subtraction then truncate) differs from the actual count of loop iterations.

Key: `b - a` is computed in float. The loop increments `a` by 1.0 each time and compares `a <= b`. The number of iterations depends on the actual float values of a (which starts at (mrb_float)beg and increments).
